title: Test results count only at the exact commit they ran on
method: The same fresh template copy as step 5 (project unplanned-proof). make check writes .code2check/junit.xml and .code2check/run.json ({commit, clean}); lockstep status reads them and reports each requirement and scenario against the current commit.

merge_side: ship runs the repository's own check and merges only the commit that passed; its log names that commit (for example #1093 merged as 42dce46b9 after the check at that commit).
caveat: lockstep status exits 0 even when a requirement is failing or not run; it reports, it does not gate. The gate is make check, which ship runs.
